mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, realName, sex, birthday, address, tel, email, registerDate, readerNumber FROM reader_info WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, realName, sex, birthday, address, tel, email, registerDate, readerNumber FROM reader_info WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
